'''Pallima''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] as a [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3960 BBY]], Pallima was the leader of the [[Gold Faction]].

Pallima attended a [[rake-riding]] event in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tahv]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], and he was decapitated by [[Flen Luzo|Flen]] and [[Sawj Luzo]], along with [[Dernas]], the leader of the rival [[Red Faction]], after the [[uvak wrangler]] [[Campion Dey]] staged an attack on [[Grand Lord]] [[Lillia Venn]].
